source.retrievalMethod: HTTP byte ranges; each CBA header and downloaded chunk verified by BLAKE2b
source.dateSemantics: Retrieved from the current official updater release on 2026-10-23. Per-asset modifiedAt is the timestamp in data.idx and may be older than the served release. Client presence does not establish public availability or server spawns.

identityMethod: Exact named client table lookup, current updater release
limitations: Client presence does not guarantee a zone is publicly accessible.
Title scenes, deprecated entries, inaccessible areas, stress tests and Free Tours are explicitly flagged.
Age of Zatana ID91 is the Free Tour variant; ID174 is the named game arena; both explicitly reference the same image.
Karkia is taken from the zone type label; raw Planet Number remains4 in the table and is preserved.
Halls of Oblivion143 and Sikuku Catacombs169 still reference blank4x4DDS assets; these are not usable map images.
No spawn positions or drops are inferred from the map files.
